column1: # The closed list of error words of the doors of the domain process: chapters 8.3, 8.4, 8.6–8.10 (ADR-0094 B5). The rules — chapter 8.0 N4; the format of field — P/06.1 N2.

# door — the doors: agents /api/member, /api/carry, /api/relay; tokens /api/tokens; login /api/login; verify /api/verify; people /domain/users…; groups /domain/groups…; roles /domain/roles…; batch /domain/batch; batches /domain/batches…;

# handover /domain/handover; stranded /domain/stranded/apply; agent-tokens — the agent's local tokens door (acceptance 8.7); * — every door of the process. For the agents the word is refined by reason (8.3 N4, 8.7 N4).

# versions — the doors of the table 8.0 N1.9: these words go with the words of their own door (members, topology, people, grants, break-glass, groups, roles, batch, placement, shared); If-Match is not read at POST /domain/users, /domain/groups, /domain/roles and at /domain/batch.
# field — what the field field carries: «-» — no field; otherwise the possible values separated by a space, <…> — a substitution: <field> — a body field, <i> — the row number from zero.
